title: qopt: a verified Clifford+T circuit optimizer for T and CNOT counts
description: qopt reduces the T count and the CNOT count of Clifford+T circuits given as Toffoli networks. It provides a unitary mode (portfolio of evolved rewriting programs, phase folding, optional neural block resynthesis) and measurement-based modes that place Gidney logical-AND gates with measurement-based uncomputation automatically, by tracking every wire as a polynomial over GF(2). Every reported circuit is re-checked by an independent state-vector simulator (up to 22 qubits) or a sum-over-paths checker; version 0.4 adds an exact equivalence prover (qoptct prove), arithmetic, GF(2^m) and binary-AND synthesis modules, a CNOT pass and time limits. Includes verified result circuits for 23 standard benchmarks in three cost models (unitary, strict measurement-based, clean ancillas), a comparison with nine quantum software tools, and reproduction scripts. Version 0.5 adds a BDD-based exact prover for large circuits with classical references (qoptct kprove) and a set of proved circuits of cryptographic building blocks (AES S-box and MixColumns, table lookups, GF(2^m) arithmetic). Version 0.6 adds compositional and algebraic exact provers for modular arithmetic at n = 256 (Kaliski inversion, multipliers, reductions) and a verified compiler for noisy IBM-like devices (qoptct hw). Python package: pip install qoptct (import qoptct); includes a Qiskit transpiler plugin (optimization_method="qoptct").
notes: Benchmark circuits in bench_qc/ are third-party data from the Feynman repository and are not covered by the Apache-2.0 license; see bench_qc/SOURCES.md.
